• Convert today's live 45min coding walkthrough to a written take-home exercise that mirrors the prompt we would have used. You will have 48 hours (until 11:30am PT on Wed, Nov 11) to submit; please send your solution as a GitHub link or zip.
• We'll evaluate against the same rubric and the same interviewers (Steph & Irene).

• Expense support: we can reimburse up to $75 for an urgent battery/repair today. Please send a photo of the repaired device or a receipt and we'll process it.
• I've attached an updated calendar item that replaces the live slot with the take-home (it includes instructions).

If that works, reply to confirm and I'll send the take-home prompt and rubric immediately. If you'd prefer an interpreter instead, we can also try to arrange that, but the take-home is the fastest path.

Take care and again — sorry for the hassle.
